 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 ✨ Turtle of Abundance & Protection Owl Dual Pendant Combo with Velore Chain

A meaningful expression of balance, protection, and prosperity—this Turtle of Abundance & Protection Owl Dual Pendant Combo from Studd Muffyn is designed for those who believe in steady growth, wisdom, and energetic protection in their journey.

This premium set features two symbolic 24K gold plated pendants:

The Turtle of Abundance Pendant represents stability, patience, and long-term prosperity. It is a symbol of grounded growth, financial consistency, and slow but powerful success energy—reminding you to move forward with calm confidence and steady progress.

The Protection Owl Pendant symbolizes wisdom, intuition, and deep awareness. On the back, it is infused with Black Obsidian crystal using resin, known for its grounding and protective energy. It is designed for those who seek clarity of mind, protection from negative energy, and stronger decision-making ability.

Both pendants are paired with a luxurious Velore Chain (24K Gold Plated), designed with a smooth, refined finish that enhances the overall elegance of the set while keeping it perfect for daily premium wear.

💎 Core Representation

This combo represents Abundance, Wisdom, Protection & Stability — a perfect harmony of growth, clarity, and energetic safety.

⚠️ Disclaimer:

Each piece is carefully crafted; slight variations may occur. Store away from water, perfume, and chemicals to maintain shine and quality.

 Benefits

♦ Protection Shield – Owl with Black Obsidian helps absorb negativity and protect energy.

♦ Wisdom Boost – Owl supports clarity, intuition, and better decision-making.

♦ Calm Confidence – Helps maintain emotional balance and focused mindset.

♦ Dual Energy Balance – Combines growth (Turtle) with protection (Owl).

♦ Premium Styling – 24K gold plated pendants with elegant Velore Chain finish.

♦ Unisex Design – Suitable for both men and women.
